control.controlName: Ensure IAM users have MFA enabled
control.manualRemediation: In the IAM console open each user > Security credentials > Assign MFA device (virtual or hardware). Enforce with an IAM policy that denies actions unless aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent is true.
control.buildTimeRemediation:
# Enforce via an IAM policy condition
condition { test = "Bool", variable = "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent", values = ["true"] }
control.rationale: MFA adds a second authentication factor, protecting accounts even if a password is leaked.

control.controlName: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14
control.manualRemediation: IAM > Account settings > Password policy > set Minimum password length to 14 or greater.
control.rationale: Longer passwords resist brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks.

control.controlName: Ensure S3 buckets are not publicly readable
control.manualRemediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access at account and bucket level; remove any ACL/policy granting AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers read.
control.rationale: Publicly readable buckets can expose sensitive data to anyone on the internet.

control.controlName: Ensure security groups do not allow 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
control.manualRemediation: Edit the security group; remove the inbound rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22 and scope it to a known CIDR or use SSM Session Manager instead.
control.rationale: Exposing SSH (22) to 0.0.0.0/0 invites brute-force and exploitation from the internet.

control.manualRemediation: Enable EBS encryption by default in the EC2 account settings; re-create or snapshot-and-restore existing unencrypted volumes as encrypted.
control.rationale: Encrypting EBS volumes protects data at rest against physical/media exposure.

control.controlName: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
control.manualRemediation: Create a multi-region CloudTrail trail with log file validation enabled, delivering to an S3 bucket with access logging.
control.rationale: CloudTrail is the audit record of API activity; without it, incidents can't be investigated.

control.controlName: Ensure RDS instances are encrypted at rest
control.manualRemediation: RDS encryption can't be toggled in place — snapshot the instance, copy the snapshot with encryption enabled, and restore from the encrypted copy.
control.rationale: Encryption at rest protects database contents if the underlying storage is compromised.
